$comment: Route table for bin/route. Edit models to match your provider. '{task}' is replaced with the prompt.

quick.description: Small, well-specified change: one or two files, no design decisions.

build.description: Normal feature or bug fix with a known shape.

deep.description: Architecture, migrations, auth, payments, data, or anything unclear.

verify.description: Check a finished change. Never edits code.
checks: run the checks the route asked for

claude.note: Claude Code: effort comes from the agent file or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL, not the CLI.
